meta.title: Join Taskote as a professional
meta.description: Skilled professionals in Kerala can register with Taskote via WhatsApp to receive local service enquiries.

hero.title: Grow your work with Taskote
hero.lead: If you are an experienced professional in Kerala, register with Taskote directly via WhatsApp to receive enquiries from customers near you.

expect.title: What to expect
expect.lead: Registration is fast and handled directly with our team on WhatsApp.
points: Connect with the Taskote team directly on WhatsApp
Share your trade, experience, and the areas you cover
Fast onboarding without complicated initial app requirements
Receive direct service enquiries from local homes, shops, and offices

bottomCta.title: Ready to join Taskote?
bottomCta.text: Send us a message on WhatsApp with your trade and location to get started.
